searchText: Could anyone please explain how to ourself generate Beacon State snappy files (pre and post) and STF operations for the same? CL clients typically have tools for this except the snappy part perhaps. You can get SSZ files from the beacon API and then use their tools for the stf. In Prysm it's prysmctl. In Teku (or perhaps nimbus I may have them changed) it's pcli. All CLs have such tools I think
